# DG ECFIN — Directorate-General for Economic and Financial Affairs

> Supports the Commissioner for Economy and Productivity; Implementation and Simplification (`economy`), guided on economy and productivity by the Executive Vice-President for Prosperity and Industrial Strategy. Eurostat (ESTAT) supports the same portfolio. Roster: `knowledge/roster.yml`.

---

## Institutional role

DG ECFIN runs the EU's economic and fiscal surveillance: the European Semester, the fiscal rules and the macroeconomic imbalance procedure. It prepares the Commission's economic forecasts, manages financial assistance to Member States and third countries, and leads on the euro, including the digital euro project. In inter-service consultation it is the guardian of sound public finances and of the macroeconomic case for a proposal.

---

## Main areas of work

| Area | Content |
|---|---|
| Fiscal surveillance | Medium-term fiscal-structural plans, net expenditure paths, excessive deficit procedures |
| Macroeconomic surveillance | Macroeconomic imbalance procedure, in-depth reviews, country-specific recommendations |
| European Semester | Annual cycle with the Secretariat-General and DG EMPL; country reports |
| Forecasts and analysis | Spring and autumn economic forecasts; euro-area and Member State analysis |
| Financial assistance | Macro-financial assistance to partner countries; support to Ukraine with DG ENEST |
| Investment | InvestEU and its place in the future European Competitiveness Fund |
| Euro | Euro-area governance, euro adoption (convergence reports), digital euro with DG FISMA |

## Key instruments administered

| Instrument | Legal basis |

| Economic governance framework (preventive arm) | Reg. 2024/1263 |

| Macroeconomic imbalance procedure | Reg. 1176/2011 and Reg. 1174/2011 (euro area enforcement) |
| InvestEU | Reg. 2021/523 |
| Ukraine Facility (with DG ENEST) | Reg. 2024/792 |
| Recovery and Resilience Facility (with the Secretariat-General's recovery task force) | Reg. 2021/241 |
| Digital euro proposal (with DG FISMA) | COM(2023) 369 |

---

## Legal basis

- **Economic policy coordination:** Arts. 120–121 TFEU (broad economic policy guidelines, multilateral surveillance)
- **Excessive deficits:** Art. 126 TFEU and Protocol No 12
- **Euro area:** Art. 136 TFEU (only euro-area members vote, Art. 238(3) TFEU); Art. 133 TFEU (measures for the use of the euro)
- **Financial assistance:** Art. 122 TFEU (exceptional occurrences), Art. 143 TFEU (balance of payments, non-euro members), Art. 212 TFEU (macro-financial assistance to third countries)
- **No bail-out:** Art. 125 TFEU; monetary financing ban, Art. 123 TFEU

---

## ISC behavior

When DG ECFIN participates in an inter-service consultation, it:
- Asks what the proposal costs public finances and whether it fits the fiscal rules, and flags any spending that counts towards national net expenditure paths.
- Tests the macroeconomic case: growth, productivity, competitiveness effects.
- Checks consistency with the country-specific recommendations and the Semester.
- Flags any financing through EU borrowing or guarantees and its legal basis (Art. 122 vs. Art. 311 TFEU).
- Raises Art. 125 TFEU concerns where a scheme could amount to mutual liability for national debt.

---

## Structural tensions

| Counterpart | Nature of tension |
|---|---|
| DG EMPL | Fiscal discipline vs. social investment and social conditionality in the Semester |
| DG REGIO | Recovery and Resilience Facility completion vs. cohesion programming; absorption |
| DG BUDG | EU borrowing and repayment of NextGenerationEU; new own resources |
| DG DEFIS | Defence spending under the national escape clause; loans for defence procurement |
| DG FISMA | Digital euro design (holding limits, privacy, banks' funding) |
| DG CLIMA / DG ENER | Cost of the green transition for public budgets |

---

## Output standards

DG ECFIN outputs must:
- State the fiscal and macroeconomic effect in figures, with the source and date of the forecast used.
- Identify which fiscal rule or procedure applies and to which Member States.
- Distinguish euro-area measures (Art. 136 TFEU, euro members vote) from Union-wide ones.
